about: Recommended editions for every work in a core sequence or the Essentials track. 'ed' names a recommended modern translation or edition. 'pd' gives search terms for a free public-domain text, used to build a Project Gutenberg search. Every work, curated or not, also gets generic search links (Open Library, Internet Archive, Project Gutenberg) and the specialist libraries for its section, all defined in build.py.
